purpose: Document target lessons that intentionally extend or synthesize the source teaching-deck curriculum without a one-to-one source-slide assignment.

records.title: Campaign Portfolios: Organizing for Scale
records.sourceRelationship: Adds an account-level portfolio abstraction that organizes campaign, budget, and pacing ideas from the source deck.

relatedSourceRoles.rationale: Portfolio grouping sits above these campaign-structure objects and gives them a scalable operating boundary.
Portfolio budgets provide the account-level home for pacing and controlled scale.
The portfolio lesson aggregates budget control and review evidence without replacing campaign-level controls.

records.reviewNotes: Keep as a strategic extension. Do not force it into a source-slide row; use related source roles for provenance instead.

records.title: Seasonal Strategy & Promo Planning
records.sourceRelationship: Adds a planning horizon above weekly optimization and controlled bid/budget changes.

relatedSourceRoles.rationale: Seasonal work uses the same pacing, safety, one-change, and evidence disciplines on a longer calendar.
Seasonal decisions still require a repeatable weekly operating rhythm and a readable experiment record.

records.reviewNotes: Keep as a planning extension. Recheck that seasonal advice remains qualified by inventory, margin, and measured performance.

records.title: Placement Adjustments: Paying for the Front Row
records.sourceRelationship: Adds standalone placement-multiplier depth to the source deck's general bid, budget, pacing, and safety material.

relatedSourceRoles.rationale: Placement exposure should be taught as a controlled bid and budget change with a ceiling, review window, and rollback record.
The target lesson operationalizes safe scale at the placement level.

records.reviewNotes: Keep separate from bid strategy and Bid Elevator prep. Preserve the distinction between a base bid, placement multiplier, realized CPC, and total exposure.

records.title: Brand Analytics: Reading the Competitive Landscape
records.sourceRelationship: Introduces Brand Analytics, search-demand context, Market Basket Analysis, demographics, and access constraints; source M8 is Search Terms & Negatives rather than Brand Analytics.

relatedSourceRoles.rationale: The target lesson extends the source's evidence-first search-gap logic into market-level demand and product-targeting inputs.
Brand Analytics findings need the same driver, action, and evidence discipline as operational reporting.

records.reviewNotes: Keep as a distinct market-intelligence lesson. Do not claim that Brand Analytics is a direct continuation of the search-term report or that correlation proves profitability.

records.title: Share of Voice Analysis & Strategic Positioning
records.sourceRelationship: Adds competitive impression-share measurement and strategic posture selection, which are absent as standalone topics from the source deck.

relatedSourceRoles.rationale: SOV posture uses the same search and opportunity signals but applies them to competitive visibility rather than term-level routing.
SOV is useful only when the driver leads to a bounded strategic action.

records.reviewNotes: Keep as a strategic extension. Do not turn SOV into a command to outbid competitors everywhere; preserve the posture and economic guardrails.

records.title: Competitor Benchmarking & Actionable Insights
records.sourceRelationship: Adds competitor selection, gap scoring, dashboard construction, and market-to-campaign translation as an applied synthesis layer.

relatedSourceRoles.rationale: Benchmarking reuses the source deck's evidence classification discipline at competitor and market level.
Competitive insights must be routed into the correct ad type and a readable campaign structure.

records.reviewNotes: Keep as the applied capstone of the Competitive Intelligence module. Avoid duplicating the SOV definition; focus on gap-to-action translation.

records.title: Explaining Numbers in Human Words
records.sourceRelationship: Synthesizes the source reporting sequence into a client-language skill rather than matching one source slide.

relatedSourceRoles.rationale: The lesson turns these distributed reporting roles into a single metric-to-meaning-to-lever workflow.

records.reviewNotes: Keep as synthesized content. Do not assign it to one direct source slide; retain the adjacent-role provenance so future editors know what was consolidated.
